description.value:
Sith purebloods are the crimson-skinned, ridge-browed descendants of the original Sith species of Korriba, later intermingled with exiled Dark Jedi to found the ancient Sith Empire. Long-lived and naturally attuned to the dark side of the Force, Sith purebloods carry an innate ferocity and an ancestral memory of conquest that few other species can match.

Even those Sith purebloods who never train in the Force possess an unnerving resilience and an intimidating bearing that marks them as the scions of a warrior-sorcerer civilization.

traits.name: Sith Resilience
traits.description: Your ancient bloodline grants you resistance to necrotic damage and to poison damage.

traits.name: Dark Side Legacy
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened, and against effects that would read your surface thoughts or emotions.

traits.name: Imposing Presence
traits.description: You are proficient in the Intimidation skill, and creatures have disadvantage on the first saving throw they make against your attempts to frighten them.
